adeCampaignAdmission.rule: one atomic directory lock serializes reconciliation and reservation for every ADE-0006A campaign because the evidence ceilings are global across Package and C0-B

lifecycle: Admission holds the atomic lock only while reconciling retained evidence and writing one bounded ledger reservation.
A ledger entry is active until collection publishes a sanitized tracked receipt or records a typed failed-unsummarized disposition.
Active campaigns reserve their full declared count and byte maxima even before raw sidecars exist.
Build targets, extracted installers, decompiler metadata, tool output, and process output remain disposable OS-temporary state and are never retained evidence.
A collection failure records one typed sanitized ledger disposition without raw error text; an interrupted active entry remains protected for explicit recovery.

Cleanup is never implicit in collection; explicit candidate-scoped cleanup preserves active entries and the sole failed-unsummarized entry, atomically removes ledger entries before deleting exact paths, and retains a bounded cleanup record.

rendererRecreationObservation.authoritativePageLoad: get_acp_chat_page for the exact project and Chat at an equal or newer projection revision
rendererRecreationObservation.sqliteInvariant: before and after reload retain the exact per-table row counts and content digests without retaining row payloads
rendererRecreationObservation.runtimeInvariant: the authoritative ACP runtime-slot active count and live process-tree reservation count are unchanged
rendererRecreationObservation.listenerInvariant: one projection subscription and one pagehide focus listener exist after authoritative load; the destroyed renderer retains zero listeners

liveRegionEvidence.rule: initial authoritative load and retained terminal history are silent; only a new same-scope terminal after reload is announced once

retentionRules: Never delete the sole unsummarized failure.
Reject a new campaign before allocation when retaining it would exceed a count or byte ceiling.
Cleanup is explicit, candidate-scoped, oldest-completed-first, and records every removed relative path and byte count.
Evidence paths are repository-relative or sanitized fixture-relative; absolute paths are forbidden.

commandTemplateContract.toolSha256Rule: exact lowercase 64-hex digest of the executable used for the campaign
commandTemplateContract.placeholderRule: symbolic names only, such as <isolated-data-dir> and <candidate-executable>; values are never retained
